scope: A01 J-SIG/J-PWR between A01-jack and A01-middle only: Stage31 B as the working option, its retention, unmating, release and the core 40 mm service, and the neighbouring volume those motions actually cross. Nothing is applied to hardware or canonical CAD.

classes.MAKER_DOC: maker or fabricator document (sources.json), with URL, revision and locator
classes.EXISTING_DESIGN: an existing repository design or study value (sources.json REPO_DESIGN)
classes.DESIGN_ASSUMPTION: a value chosen or derived for this study; the note says why
classes.UNCONFIRMED: no source; the value stays null and is never used as a fact

wire_od_max_mm.note: Upper end of the SSHL-002T-P0.2 insulation OD window; every envelope uses it.

gh_mated_height_mm.note: Reference value in parentheses on p.2.

gh_unmating_angle_deg.note: General JST precaution: hold the wire bundle and operate within 15 degrees of the mating axis; a GH-specific manual value would take priority (S-JST-GATED, not obtained).

gh_unmating_stroke_mm.note: No JST document read states an unmating stroke.

gh_latch_side.note: The catalog says 'large outer latch'; which long face carries it is not stated. Both faces are evaluated.

gh_bundle_grip_length_mm.note: Straight bundle length needed to hold the bundle within 15 degrees; not stated by JST.

geometric_separation_mm.note: Derived from JST reference dimensions only; it is not an unmating stroke and is not used to shorten the release travel.

release_travel_mm.note: Stage10 sweep basis 'Mated 7.3 mm + 15 mm axial release'. Kept as the design basis; shorter travels are sensitivity only.

release_travel_sensitivity_mm.note: Sensitivity only; 2.45 is the derived geometric separation, 15 the Stage10 basis.

wire_bend_rule_x_od.note: Every identified candidate states 'Bend Radius 10X Cable Diameter'. No wire is selected.

design_bend_radius_mm.note: Stage31 assumption (5 x OD). Checked here against the maker rule; it is not raised by convenient rounding.

bend_radius_sensitivity_mm.note: 5 = Stage31 route; 8.9-11 = maker 10 x OD for the candidate wires incl. the bundle offset.

round_bundle_factor.note: Hexagonal 7 and ring of 4; holds only for a tightly dressed bundle (sleeve or wrap). A loose bundle is not covered.

placement_margin_mm.note: Wire placement allowance; explicit part tolerances are added on top of it in Stage32.

robust_spare_mm.note: Stage31 K4 threshold; Stage32 applies it after the explicit tolerance stack and does not relax it.

panel_rear_z_mm.note: Stage10 mechanical-report panel_rear_z_mm 0; the 2 mm panel front is at z -2.

foreign_pcb_plane_z_mm.note: A code default, not a designed board. Its outline does not exist.

foreign_board_outline.note: No A02-A06 / E2-E5 board outline, plane, thickness or support exists in architecture-278.

toggle_body_and_terminal_mm.note: Drawing of the -5 suffix; equivalence to the unsuffixed 2MS3T1B1M2QES in the lock is OPEN (R-TOGGLE-FACTS).

carrier_proof_MPa.note: Minimum 0.2 % proof stress of the supplier product form; machined-part certification is not established.

strength_safety_factor.note: On the minimum proof stress, applied to the conservative peak stress.

load_sensitivity_N.note: Handling and service loads are not specified anywhere; the range shows where the notched rail stops meeting the criterion.

notch_corner_radius_sensitivity_mm.note: End-mill corner radii a machinist could use.

flat_tool_mm.note: Thickness x width of a flat tool used to reach a latch; a clear tool path is not finger operability.

panel_front_z_mm.note: Panel rear z 0 minus the Stage10 2 mm panel thickness proposal.

wire_candidates.note: Silver plating is outside the JST 'as a rule' wire (S-JST-CRIMP).

pcb_bow_fraction.note: IPC-6012 SMT limit (standard not retained). JLC states no bow value (S-JLC-CAP is negative evidence only). Base model: half sine along y over the A01-middle length y 142-292, toward the carrier; sensitivity in bow_cases.

carrier_face_mm.note: Drawing tolerance to be put on the tab top, notch floor and notch walls.

saddle_seat_mm.note: Moulded or printed saddle seat thickness; no part exists yet.

strap_thickness_mm.note: Integral strap band; no part exists yet.

mount_hole_float_mm.note: 2.7 mm drill around a 2.5 mm screw, half the diametral gap.

panel_to_carrier_registration_mm.note: The carriers bolt to new enclosure cleats that are not designed; no chain to the panel exists.

strap_bore_mm.note: Strap/seat bore diameter tolerance of a moulded or printed guide.

saddle_seating_mm.note: Seating play of the saddle on the notch floor through the barb/groove fit.

retention_rules.kind: captive guide: a saddle seated in the notch with an integral strap; the bundle can slide axially so the release slack comes from the local loop

B32.title: Stage31 B with captive notch guides, lowered runs for an explicit tolerance stack, and J-PWR:middle 0.7 mm toward -y

incumbent canonical stack (different architecture; conditional candidate, fit NOT RUN)

assembly: Bench: dress each cable as a tight round bundle (sleeve or wrap) and crimp/insert per JST tooling (vendor, Q-H01).
Fit the jack carrier and A01-jack; fit the middle carrier with R1/R2 saddles snapped into notches N1/N2 (legs into the flank grooves).

Mate J-SIG:local and J-PWR:local from the rear (+z) and form the free local slack loops left of x 232 (modelled as a two-leg stand-up loop, top z about 71, 78.5 with the local end withdrawn; real loop shape is a surrogate until M32-08 / M-12).
Lay each bundle in its saddle and close the strap latch (rail top exposed, A01-middle not yet fitted).

Bench: mate the J-SIG/J-PWR middle housings onto the A01-middle headers; before the rear (core) carrier is fitted, lower A01-middle onto its spacers along -z with the hooks hanging below it, feeding slack back through the guides; fit the four screws, then the rear carrier.
Fit the core onto the DIN connector and connect K-PWR last.
service_core: Power off and discharge; remove the rear cover.
Disconnect K-PWR; release the four core screws; support both handles and withdraw the core 40 mm along +z. J-SIG and J-PWR are not touched.
service_middle_connectors: Power off. Remove the front panel; front access to the middle headers needs the corridor in reservation RV-ACCESS, or the neighbouring front boards removed with the panel (owner decision).

Press the GH latch with a flat tool, hold the bundle and pull within 15 degrees of -z until the housing is free; the bundle slides through the closed R1/R2 and the local slack loop shortens by the same length.
Refit: push the housing on until it latches; draw the slack back into the local loop.
harness_replacement: Remove the core (K-PWR first, 40 mm, then fully), the rear (core) carrier and A01-middle along +z; open the R1/R2 strap latches with a flat tool from +z with the rail top exposed. Front access cannot reach either latch (R1 tab over the rail, R2 corridor blocked by crossmember:jack:1 and the SW1501 column).

bow_cases.note: half sine along the M1-M3 mount line
base: half sine over the board length
0.75 % of the A01-middle outline diagonal applied everywhere (interior bow of a four-corner-supported board)
